principle: 左頁不是整座黎明書局，而是一個有輕重層級的索引。更完整的館藏細分類與封面瀏覽在下一個 leaf/spread 中展開。結構與最終現代設計語言共同決定如何讓大量館藏可理解、可選擇。

leftLeaf.rule: 只放最短路徑和高頻入口；不得列出完整分類樹、來源機構清單、語言清單或大量書目。

browseTransition.trigger: 使用者從左頁選擇『館藏』、分類入口、搜索的『查看更多』或三晨星中的擴展瀏覽。
browseTransition.behavior: open-book workspace 向下一個 leaf/spread 展開，而不是把第一左頁無限加長。
browseTransition.continuity: 保持一本書/一組紙頁的空間連續性，但最終 motion grammar 留給全站現代設計探索。

collectionBrowseLeaf.purpose: 真正展開黎明書局的細分類和視覺選書。

examples: 文學與其他非聖經作品

taxonomyLayers.role: 細分類/時期/傳統/主題/語言/來源等 facets
taxonomyLayers.rule: 只展示已有實際 canonical Works 的分類；零內容結構不出現在前台。
以作品為單位，不把 edition/volume/source record 偽裝成多本書。

coverRole.principle: Work result 必須盡可能具有封面/書影視覺，使選書不是純文字 catalog。
fallbacks: designed typographic cover generated from canonical metadata only when no authentic visual is available and clearly treated as interface representation, not historical artifact
coverRole.identity: cover belongs to an Edition/visual source relation while selection resolves to canonical Work.

avoid: uniform tiny list rows as the only view
showing source duplicates as separate books

selectionFlow: browse leaf selects canonical Work -> workspace returns/folds to reading spread -> right leaf opens the Work; left index remembers the browse context so the reader can return without losing place.
searchFlow: search suggestions may remain lightweight on first left leaf; large result sets expand into the visual browse leaf with covers and facets.
threeMorningStars: 三晨星 stays prominent on the first left index because it is a recommendation standard, but expanding it can use the same cover-based browse leaf rather than inventing a separate UI system.
designDependency: This structure intentionally leaves card geometry, cover scale, grid/list rhythm, transitions, typography and material treatment undecided. Those must be solved together during the later modern editorial/digital-publishing layout exploration, using the same site-wide design grammar while preserving Dawn Library's open-book identity.
designInvariant: 第一左頁讓人知道去哪裡找；下一 leaf 讓人真正看見有哪些書；右頁讓人讀。三者不能壓成一個 catalogue screen。
next: Inventory the actual canonical collection taxonomy and current cover/image availability so the browse leaf is based on real holdings rather than invented empty categories.
